summary: New Pacific Metals Corp filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a voluntary current report for a Canadian foreign private issuer) to furnish its fiscal 2027 Q1 financial results for the three months ended September 30, 2026, alongside a news release. The report discloses a net loss of $1.42 million ($0.01 per share), working capital of $35.94 million, and operational updates: signature of 30-year Administrative Mining Contracts for the Carangas project (now pending Bolivian legislative ratification) and an updated NI 43-101 preliminary economic assessment showing a $2.65 billion post-tax NPV. No transaction, board recommendation, or shareholder event is present; the filing is routine periodic disclosure.
